open_choices: H-BM1 'half the source's candidates' is half the registered count (749, 93), whatever the start check removes.
H-BM1 sensitivity adds every unconfirmed O_nf candidate (budget, stalled or numerical) whose κ at its last point exceeds 10; the counts by outcome are listed.
Hypotheses use O_nf refinements only; O_tr (X2e) is descriptive, as registered in 3.1.
H-BM3: if no statement fails and at least one is not testable, the overall result is 'unresolved' with the untestable statements named.
Distance in u between two minima uses the mean of their bound widths (equal within a data set unless the box depends on the state).
A candidate whose run raised an exception counts as unconfirmed (numerical) for the denominator and is listed.
